metadata.description: aidd: the toolkit for AI-Driven Development (AIDD): build production-ready, maintainable software with AI agents, proven at every step and auditable after. Agents do the work, and a person decides the risky steps they keep. A skill, an MCP server with advice tools, and an optional delivery team of agent roles.

plugins.name: aidd
plugins.description: AIDD, one loop from intent to production: one skill, and aidd's advice as MCP tools (the route of a change, the risk level of an action, and the checks of a Spec).

plugins.name: aidd-cli
plugins.description: Optional: the aidd command on the PATH of Claude Code's Bash tool, with no other install. A plugin of its own, because claude.ai and Cowork do not install a plugin that has a bin/ folder.

relevance.topic: the aidd command in Claude Code

plugins.name: aidd-team
plugins.description: Optional: run the aidd loop as a delivery team of agent roles, each applying its discipline's industry standards, with a domain pack per domain and practice skills per kind of work, every standard carrying a checked date (or a reviewed date for a practice), and an edition and source where the document has one. Ships one command per team flow, from onboarding a repository, writing a proposal, or building an MVP, to a quick fix, a rollout, and the retrospective. Needs the aidd plugin.
